title: Bump opum-lore federated entry to lore-cli v0.4.4
summary: lore-cli released v0.4.4 (tag v0.4.4, commit f7bc26769e795bed74e88547856ea09523d8c2d5 on main; all seven packages live on the registry; LCLI-447/451). Unlike v0.4.3, plugin.json at this tag reads 0.4.4 -- verified by fetching it via gh api before editing, since OMARK-3'\''s automated guard for this is not built yet. Update the opum-lore entry'\''s source.ref in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json from v0.4.3 to v0.4.4. Nothing else in the entry changes; opum-workflow'\''s own plugin.json version does not move.

acceptanceCriteria.text: git ls-remote --tags confirms v0.4.4 resolves on opum-ai/lore-cli before the change lands
gh api confirms .claude-plugin/plugin.json at v0.4.4 reads version 0.4.4 (manual stand-in for OMARK-3, which is not built yet)
opum-lore entry source.ref == "v0.4.4" and nothing else in the entry changed

plan: 4. Commit, push, PR, wait for CI, squash to dev
finalSummary: Bumped opum-lore ref v0.4.3 -> v0.4.4 (lore-cli commit f7bc26769e795bed74e88547856ea09523d8c2d5). Verified via gh api that .claude-plugin/plugin.json at v0.4.4 reads version 0.4.4 before editing (OMARK-3's automated check doesn't exist yet, so this was a manual stand-in) -- unlike v0.4.3, this pin will actually register as an update. Only source.ref changed; opum-workflow's plugin.json untouched.
